hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo 'SessionStart re-check, run before NEXT.md is read:' && { GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch -q origin || echo 'git fetch failed: the counts below are against the last fetch'; } && git status -sb && { u=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{upstream}' 2>/dev/null) && echo "behind, unpushed against $u: $(git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD')" || echo 'this branch has no upstream: behind and unpushed not counted'; } && grep -m1 '^Updated' NEXT.md
